name: fixedk30_ablation_C_drop_final_rank_noprov
description: Variant B (no provenance): the adopted ablation-C feature set (drop the three heuristic retrieval-rank features) MINUS the two query-provenance categorical features text_family and text_query_source. Use with scripts/train_hgbc_reranker.py --exclude-features-file. Companion to Variant A (same ablation-C set with the provenance features retained under --categorical-mode stable).
rationale: text_family / text_query_source were table-relative pd.Categorical codes (batch-composition-dependent, not production-safe; see HANDOFF_2026-07-29_TRANSFER_AND_PRODUCTION_SAFE_RERANKER.md section 8). Variant B removes them entirely; Variant A re-encodes them with a fixed training-derived vocabulary (__MISSING__/__UNKNOWN__ reserved categories, sklearn-native categorical splits). Selection between A and B is on val_dev Recall@5 under the frozen Step H protocol.
